首次连接 NUT: Connect to NUT for the first time
程序通过 NUT 读取 UPS 状态，默认端口是 3493。首次使用请在“连接设: The app reads UPS status through NUT; its default port is 3493. On first use, enter the UPS server address, port, and device name on the Connection page, save, and wait for the status to update. If ACCESS-DENIED appears, add this computer's address to the allowed client list in the NUT settings on the NAS or UPS server. For other connection failures, check network reachability, the port, and the device name. Page names differ between NAS products, so follow the server documentation to find the allowed-client setting. The app only reads data and does not change UPS configuration.
概览显示的是 UPS 上所有设备的整体负载，不只是本机。服务器能提供实测瓦数时优: Overview shows the total load of every device on the UPS, not just this computer. When the server provides measured watts, the app prefers that value; otherwise it estimates watts as the UPS rated watts multiplied by the load percentage and labels it as estimated. If no measured value is available and information needed for the estimate is missing, it shows Unknown. The rated output comes from the UPS or server information and must not be changed just to match a power meter. A plug-in meter helps you observe the actual draw at the computer or outlet, but its measurement has a different scope from total UPS load and does not have to match. The app cannot reduce other devices' load.
高负载条件必须严格超过“触发阈值”并持续确认，默认 5 秒后才降本机功耗；等于阈: A high-load condition must be strictly above the trigger threshold for the confirmation period; the default is 5 seconds before local power is reduced. Being exactly at the threshold does not trigger it. Recovery requires the load to stay below trigger threshold minus hysteresis for 30 seconds by default. For example, an 80% threshold with 10% hysteresis needs more than 80% for 5 seconds to act, then below 70% for 30 seconds to restore. Hysteresis prevents boundary chatter. Set the threshold against the UPS rating and actual need; do not exceed the rating arbitrarily.
CPU 最大处理器状态是 Windows 电源计划的上限，不等于任务管理器的 C: The CPU maximum processor state is the Windows power-plan ceiling, not Task Manager CPU utilization and not an exact wattage limit. The app records and attempts to apply a lower CPU ceiling. GPU value 0 disables GPU control; a wattage range is accepted only when a supported local GPU interface is detected. On restore, the app restores only limits it owns that have not been overwritten externally. Conflicts or failures keep the recovery record and show a prompt; the original value is not guaranteed to be written back unconditionally.
低电量保护只在 UPS 正处于电池供电时判断：电量低于阈值或预计续航低于阈值，默: Low-battery protection is evaluated only while the UPS is on battery. If charge or estimated runtime falls below its threshold, the default confirmation is 5 seconds, followed by a configurable countdown. Mains return, cleared conditions, or expired UPS data cancel hibernation during the countdown. When it reaches zero, Windows hibernation is requested and automatic protection is paused. This is hibernation, not a forced shutdown: Windows attempts to preserve the session, but each app decides whether it saves files.
本版把限功耗与休眠合并为一个“自动保护”开关，该开关要求管理员身份；读取 UPS: This release combines power limiting and hibernation in one “automatic protection” switch, and that switch requires administrator access. Reading the UPS, viewing load, and ordinary settings do not require it. “Open as administrator” only restarts the app elevated; it does not enable protection. New configurations start disabled, while a saved state may remain active after an administrator launch, so use the Overview state on every start. If a previous recovery record exists, use “Pause and restore limits” before enabling protection manually.
“暂停并恢复限制”会关闭新的自动动作；若本程序仍在执行操作，会等操作结束后尝试恢: “Pause and restore limits” stops new automatic actions. If an operation is still running, the app waits for it to finish and then attempts to restore CPU/GPU limits it owns that have not been overwritten externally. A conflict or failed restore keeps the recovery record and shows a prompt. The tray menu's “Exit and restore limits” completes the same process before actually exiting. The window X or “Minimize to tray” only hides the window while monitoring continues. Startup at sign-in requires administrator setup; the Overview state on each start determines whether protection is enabled.
休眠会尽量保留 Windows 会话状态，但不等于替所有软件保存文档、检查点或计: Hibernation tries to preserve the Windows session, but it does not save documents, checkpoints, or computation progress for every app, and it cannot guarantee network connections, remote sessions, drivers, or external devices will recover. Long-running computations should use their own save or checkpoint feature, and important files should be saved first. UPS Guardian only requests hibernation when conditions are met; it does not scan apps and save for them. After resume, verify power and task state, then use the Overview to decide whether to enable protection again.
程序通常每 2 秒轮询一次；短暂断线时暂用最后一份有效数据，不会立刻清除计时。只: The app normally polls every 2 seconds. During a short disconnect it temporarily uses the last valid sample and does not clear timers immediately. Only after that sample exceeds its freshness period does the policy clear pending trigger timers and pause new power-reduction or hibernation actions; a limit already applied successfully remains. After reconnection, the confirmation period must be met again. If a previous limit was not restored, protection stays disabled and the app asks you to use “Pause and restore limits” first. A disconnect never invents a load or makes a shutdown decision.
版本更新、支持开发与后续平台: Updates, supporting development, and future platforms
版本页可检查 GitHub 发布、查看更新记录并下载在线更新。安装前必须暂停保护: The Updates page checks GitHub releases, shows release history, and downloads online updates. Pause protection and restore the original limits before installing. The updater verifies the downloaded file, attempts rollback on failure, and keeps settings, logs, and recovery records in the data directory. The Support page's QR codes are optional and do not change any feature. Check the version and connection after updating. The current release targets Windows; macOS support will continue in a later phase.
